newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins steady in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins steady in thin trade.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds were steady on Tuesday after a brief decline in early trading initiated by London banks, and dealers said market activity seemed still depressed by last week's freezes.
Trading started from higher levels than yesterday's close but London started a sell-off which proved brief, Mosbiznesbank dealer Igor Potapov said.
"Prices, except for the sixth and seventh tranches, have already recovered early levels," he added.
Another Russian bank dealer said the morning's moves did not represent the start of a trend as the market remained cautious after further freezes of bonds.

Vneshtorgbank, the main depositary for the bonds, said on Thursday and Friday Russia's police had frozen MinFin bonds with a face value of $10.73 million this month. The total nominal value of all MinFin bonds outstanding is $11 billion.
